summary: Freelance Android developer with 19 years of software engineering, 12 of them on Android.

I built Akinator for Android (100M+ downloads), then worked on demanding consumer apps: Proton Pass (security, millions of users, 99.7% crash-free, rated 4.9 on Google Play), Louis Vuitton’s flagship app (LVMH), Stellantis, Bouygues Telecom (Android TV) and now France Télévisions.
Before Android, I spent 6 years in video streaming R&D (Envivio, Broadpeak, Harmonic, Technicolor – HLS, DASH, Smooth Streaming). Video players, OTT and Android TV are my natural playground.
strengths: XML → Jetpack Compose migrations and reusable multi-theme design systems
Maintainable, tested Clean Architecture / MVVM and MVI codebases
End-to-end product features, in close collaboration with product, design and QA
Production quality: stability, performance and monitoring
An AI-assisted workflow to ship faster without sacrificing code quality
